title: Statistical Physics II
description: Statistical physics at the advanced undergraduate level, following 8.044: the canonical ensemble and its partition function, interacting classical gases and the van der Waals equation of state, the Ising model and mean-field theory, the grand canonical ensemble, random variables and thermal fluctuations, the ideal Bose gas with Bose-Einstein condensation and blackbody radiation, the ideal Fermi gas, and transport.
cosmologyNeeds: The thermal history of the universe is statistical physics in an expanding box: the Bose-Einstein and Fermi-Dirac distributions give the energy density and number density of photons, neutrinos and electrons at each temperature, the grand canonical ensemble with a chemical potential describes how particles stay in or fall out of equilibrium, and the degenerate Fermi gas holds up white dwarfs and neutron stars. Mean free paths and transport describe when photons stop scattering off electrons, which is when the CMB was released.
notes: The source is Xiao-Gang Wen's nine chapters of handwritten lecture notes (scanned, no text layer), read from page images; Chapter VII (the Bose gas) comes in two PDFs, stored here as 7 and 7.5. The two supplementary notes are typed chapters from Wen's own book draft and are listed as supplements 10 and 11. OCW's only "courtesy" credit is for the course image; check each PDF for figures from Huang's Statistical Mechanics (the course text) before reusing any figure, and draw our own diagrams. There are no videos.

themes.title: Ensembles
themes.blurb: The canonical and grand canonical ensembles, the partition function and the free energies they give.

themes.title: Interactions and phase transitions
themes.blurb: The van der Waals gas, the Ising model and mean-field theory: how interactions make liquids and magnets.

themes.title: Fluctuations
themes.blurb: Random variables, the central limit theorem and why thermal fluctuations of large systems are small.

themes.title: Quantum gases
themes.blurb: Bose and Fermi gases: condensation, blackbody radiation, degenerate electrons and the stars they hold up.

themes.title: Transport
themes.blurb: Mean free paths, the Boltzmann equation, viscosity, conduction and diffusion.
